name: site-locale-control
description: Site Locale Control, a Manifest V3 extension that sets the time zone and language selected sites see.

scripts.build: node scripts/gen-snippets.mjs && node scripts/gen-icons.mjs && node scripts/build-patch.mjs && wxt build
scripts.typecheck: node scripts/gen-snippets.mjs && node scripts/gen-icons.mjs && node scripts/build-patch.mjs && wxt prepare && tsc --noEmit
scripts.test: node scripts/gen-snippets.mjs && node scripts/gen-icons.mjs && node scripts/build-patch.mjs && wxt prepare && vitest run
scripts.e2e: node scripts/gen-snippets.mjs && node scripts/gen-icons.mjs && node scripts/build-patch.mjs && node e2e/run.mjs
